mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was the most worthwhile action because the slipping sequence connected touch, nerves and muscle work to a familiar task.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to attach the sensitive skin was confusing because the goal did not explain that the arm had to receive its supplies first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the skin could not be attached until after the arm was connected to the supply network.

arbitrary.text: The required order for supplying the arm before adding skin felt arbitrary; the goal named both needs without making that sequence clear.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter if it offered another familiar task that brings body systems together. The final feedback loop was interesting, although several earlier combinations were predictable.
